bearingSource: OSM way 267206319 long axis 70.5°; +X points to the rounded east end of the outline (ENE), i.e. the semicircular altar apse seen on the right of photos 01–03 with the lateral apse and the two towers to its west
approximations: No published dimensions were found. The OSM outline (32.6 × 17.3 m) is a coarse rectangle with a rounded end; the body (≈ 26.3 × 12 m plus a semicircular apse) and the lateral apses are placed from the photographs. Heights are scaled from photos 01 and 02 (walls ≈ 9 m on a 1.2 m plinth, naos tower cross ≈ 25 m, pronaos tower slightly lower). Only the south-east side is photographed; the north side is mirrored and the west front is interpreted. Window frames and the painted tower friezes are simplified. Photo 04 shows the cells and gate building and was used for context only. The roofed buildings are not documented: the recorded titanium-zinc quantity exceeds this roof, so other precinct buildings were probably covered too; only the main church is modelled, with all its roofs, cones and tower caps in natural titanium-zinc because the photographs (2006–2009) predate the 2023 works.

note.ro: Machetă interpretată după fotografii de referință publice; dimensiunile și înălțimile sunt estimate, iar fațada nordică este interpretată. Fotografiile sunt anterioare lucrărilor, de aceea acoperișurile, conurile absidelor și coifurile turlelor sunt redate din titan-zinc natural (elZinc Natural), livrat de COLOR METAL conform evidențelor sale; materialul a acoperit probabil și alte clădiri ale mănăstirii, dar este modelată doar biserica mare.
note.hu: Nyilvános referenciafotók alapján értelmezett makett; a méretek és magasságok becsültek, az északi homlokzat értelmezett. A fotók a munkálatok előttiek, ezért a tetők, az apszisok kúpjai és a tornyok sisakjai natúr titáncinkből (elZinc Natural) jelennek meg, amelyet a COLOR METAL szállított nyilvántartása szerint; az anyag valószínűleg a kolostor más épületeire is került, de csak a főtemplom készült el.
note.en: Scale model interpreted from public reference photographs; dimensions and heights are estimated and the north side is interpreted. The photographs predate the works, so the roofs, apse cones and tower caps are shown in natural titanium-zinc (elZinc Natural) supplied by COLOR METAL according to its records; the material probably also covered other buildings of the monastery, but only the main church is modelled.
